content.short: Beam Cash offers a fast off-ramp to cash out crypto to bank accounts.
content.description: Beam Cash makes payments simpler by bridging funds from blockchain accounts to bank accounts and digital wallets in the real world, enabling transfers as easy as sending money to a friend. It offers a fast, secure off-ramp for customers and provides developers with a straightforward way to embed Beam into their platforms to attract and retain users across Ethereum, Arbitrum, Avalanche, Polygon, Bitcoin, Solana, OP Mainnet, and BNB Chain.
content.meta: Beam Cash is an off-ramp payments platform that lets users cash out crypto to bank accounts. Discover Beam Cash and other Web3 apps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
